plan: PLAN.md (predictions, thresholds and rules copied below; PLAN text is authoritative)
categories: composable >= 0.90; fail <= 0.20; otherwise partial (observed and derived alike)
paths: plus / minus / alternating, 2N steps each, from the world start (H, T, N); B: plus 30, minus 6, alt 6 from the world start; A: month as H, daysago plus from two (7), minus from nine (7), alternating from five (10)

predictions.G3_0: RRR-16 natural one-way R_2N >= 0.95 (daysago R_7) in all five domains AND v1 C1 R_2 <= 0.20 for 5 domains x 3 seeds; otherwise stop
predictions.HS1: F{1} one-way plus R_2N <= 0.20 in all 4 cyclic domains (shared prediction)
predictions.HS2: F{1} alternating R_2N: frozen-plane >= 0.80, H-drift <= 0.20 (weekday, month)
predictions.HS3: F{1} one-way plus: frozen-plane A_N >= 0.80 and A_ceil(N/2) <= 0.30; H-drift A_N <= 0.30 (weekday, month)
predictions.frozen_plane_rule: HS1 pass and HS2, HS3 match the frozen-plane expectation in both weekday and month
predictions.HS4: F_not1 one-way plus R_2N category per domain (4). H-fund: all >= 0.90; H-complete: all <= 0.20; H-vote: locked derived category (calib.bart.<d>.derived.F_not1.category.plus). Count matches per hypothesis; the unique hypothesis with 4/4 wins; domains where H-fund and H-vote predict the same category are flagged "not discriminating"
predictions.HS5: single-plane freeze F{j}, j >= 2, one-way plus R_2N category (weekday 2, month 5, compass 1, egoside 1 = 9 cells). H-fund: all composable; H-complete: all fail; H-vote: locked categories. A hypothesis passes with >= 7/9 matches
predictions.HS6: domains with dim(K*) < N-1: E_K* R_2N >= 0.90 on all three paths AND RRR-dim(K*) one-way R_2N <= 0.20; gate: E_all >= 0.90 on all three paths else the domain is not evaluable; pass if >= 75% of evaluable applicable domains hold
predictions.HV1: conflict conditions (F_S with S non-empty, E_K with K not all planes; 3 paths; 4 domains): per world and step, model argmax == parsed decoded state, parsable outputs only. Pass: full-model agreement >= 0.85 and >= each control (equal, fundamental-only) + 0.05; if a control is already >= 0.95: "not discriminating"
predictions.Q5: frozen-plane established if HS1-HS3 pass; H-vote if HS4 and HS5 match H-vote and HV1 passes; H-fund if HS4 and HS5 match H-fund and the fitted model is not better than fundamental-only in HV1; H-complete if HS4 and HS5 match H-complete; else mixed
predictions.B1p: pron3 and name3 RRR-16 one-way R_6 >= 0.95 (all hypotheses)
predictions.B2p: bind3 max(RRR-16, RRR-32) one-way R_6: H-bind <= 0.50, H-geom >= 0.95, H-list <= 0.50
predictions.B2bp: bind3fix max(RRR-16, RRR-32) one-way R_6: H-bind >= 0.95, H-geom >= 0.95, H-list <= 0.50
predictions.B3p: C1 R_2 <= 0.20 for every domain x seed (all hypotheses)
predictions.B4p: slot R2(bind3) - min(pron3, name3, bind3fix): H-bind <= -0.30, H-geom |.| < 0.10; measured before the lock (value in gates.bart.B4p_delta), not prospective
predictions.Q2p: B1p fail -> not decidable; else (B2p, B2bp): (<=0.50, >=0.95) H-bind; (>=0.95, >=0.95) H-geom; (<=0.50, <=0.50) H-list; else mixed
predictions.N_admission: dev single >= 0.90 after 600 updates, else one retrain with 2400 updates; still failing -> "cannot learn", excluded from N1-N3
predictions.N1: sigma_max maps: median M1 over admitted (map, seed) cells <= 0.60 (both hypotheses); M1 >= 0.90 -> "unexplained"
predictions.N2: per sigma_max map, seed-median C1 one-way R_2: H-state if >= 0.50 for >= 2 of 3 maps; H-token if <= 0.20 for >= 2 of 3 maps
predictions.N3: probe on the C1 first-step state, median over admitted sigma_max cells: H-state if target >= 0.50; H-token if source >= 0.80
predictions.Q6: conclude only when N2 and N3 support the same hypothesis; else mixed
predictions.T0: per T domain: max(RRR-16, RRR-32) natural one-way R_2N >= 0.95; otherwise T3, T5, T6 not evaluable in that domain
predictions.T1: C1 R_1 >= 0.90 and R_2 <= 0.20 for every domain x seed (v2 S5: B3 direction)
predictions.T2: C1 medians over (domain, seed): M1 >= 0.90, |M2| <= 0.20, M3 source >= 0.80 -> H-instr; M1 <= 0.60 or M2 >= 0.50 or target >= 0.80 -> H-approx; else neither
predictions.T3: per evaluable domain: r* = smallest grid rank with one-way R_2N >= 0.95 at it and all larger grid ranks; pass if N-2 <= r* <= N and the largest grid rank below r* has R_2N <= 0.20; T3 passes if all evaluable domains pass (v2 S5: R1)
predictions.T4: single-step success >= 0.95 at r = N-2 (weekday 5, month 10) (v2 S5: R2)
predictions.T5: weekday and month: sigma_max max(RRR-16, RRR-32) one-way R_2N >= 0.95 and RRR-16 R_10N(natural) - R_10N(sigma_max) <= 0.05 (v2 S5: A1-A3)
predictions.T6: on T5Gemma with its own calibration: HS1 and HS2 hold, HV1 passes, and the HS4 winner equals BART's HS4 winner
predictions.S5_original: "A1-A3, R1-R2, B3 的方向与 BART 一致" (v2 PLAN section 9), concretised as T1, T3-T5
predictions.A_H_weight: lambda = 10: seed-median month one-way R_24 >= 0.90 and seed-median daysago one-way R_7 >= 0.90
predictions.A_H_conflict: H-weight fails AND the RRR-initialised C3 drifts: its seed-median DRIFT > DRIFT of v2 RRR-16 and its seed-median one-way R (month R_24, daysago R_7) <= 0.90 in at least one domain
predictions.A3: 12 month C3 editors (v1 lambda=1 x3, lambda=3 x3, lambda=10 x3, RRR-init x3): count where (one-way R_12 >= 0.90) == (k=1 in the unit block); pass if >= 10/12
